title: Daastan Gham ki
body:
daastan gham ki raqam kuch yun sakina kar gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
uski rag rag mein hussain ibne ali ka khoon hai
kaun kehta hai sakina qaid mein thi darr gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
daastan gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
char saala ek bacchi qaid hoke shaam mein
ek alag zindan mein hai deen ki khaatir gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
daastan gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar manoos bibi hogayi zindan mein
shaam hi mein reh gayi wapas na apne ghar gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
daastan gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
phuphi amma aao dekho shaam ke zindan mein
baba baba kehte kehte haye sakina mar gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
daastan gham ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen pe masooma ka aisa hogaya charcha ameer
sar kate qaime jalay aur chadare athar gayi
rang wo tasveer e deen mein apne khoon se bhar gayi
daastan gham ki...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
